shows.title: Early Assembly performance
shows.copy: One of the earliest documented Cape Town listings for BEAST, billed as a new supergroup built from members of Lark, Taxi Violence and The Plastics.

shows.title: Oppikoppi Sweet Thing
shows.copy: BEAST played Oppikoppi 18 Sweet Thing; contemporary post-festival coverage singled the band out as one of the weekend highlights.

shows.venue: Cloof Wine Estate, Darling, Western Cape
shows.title: Rocking the Daisies
shows.copy: BEAST appeared at the 2012 Rocking the Daisies festival during its sold-out Western Cape run.

shows.title: Synergy Live Festival
shows.copy: BEAST joined the national-heavy Synergy Live bill headlined by The Prodigy, alongside Jack Parow, Prime Circle, Van Coke Kartel, The Narrow and many more.

shows.title: Up the Creek
shows.copy: BEAST were among the announced South African acts for Up the Creek 2013, alongside Karen Zoid, ISO, YOAV, Jeremy Loops and others.

shows.title: Smoke Swig Swear album launch
shows.copy: Official Cape Town launch for the debut album Smoke Swig Swear.

shows.title: Design Indaba Music Circuit
shows.copy: BEAST played at 23:30 after The Dollfins and Taxi Violence on the opening night of Design Indaba Music Circuit 2013.

shows.venue: Circle of Dreams, Riviersonderend, Western Cape
shows.title: RAMfest Cape Town
shows.copy: BEAST appeared at the Cape Town leg of RAMfest 2013, part of the festival edition headlined by Rise Against, Bring Me The Horizon and Pendulum.

shows.title: RAMfest Johannesburg
shows.copy: BEAST were also on the Johannesburg RAMfest bill at Riversands Farm, extending the 2013 festival run into Gauteng.

shows.title: Bardo private acoustic launch
shows.copy: A private acoustic performance for album backers, family and friends, radically reworking BEAST material for the room.

shows.title: Bardo album launch
shows.copy: Public launch period for BEAST’s second album Bardo following its crowdfunding and recording campaign.

shows.title: Park Acoustics
shows.copy: A documented Pretoria appearance at Park Acoustics. Contemporary coverage places BEAST on the bill directly after Sannie Fox.

shows.title: Splashy Fen
shows.copy: BEAST joined Splashy Fen over Easter weekend on a national bill featuring Taxi Violence, Matthew Mole, Shortstraw, aKING, Dan Patlansky and many more.
